An '''induction spur''' was a filament that allowed [[Trang Robotics]]' [[Duelist Elite/Legends|Duelist Elite]] to create a low-level [[Electromagnetic field/Legends|electromagnetic field]]. The field boosted the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensory]] abilities in close proximity. The spur was powered by [[voltage generator]]s on the droid's back.<ref name="EGTD" />
